periods.label: Four weeks before
tasks: Set date, venue and guest target

periods.label: Three weeks before
tasks: Send invitations and request guest needs

periods.label: 48 hours before
tasks: Buy fresh food, drinks and ice
Pack décor by room or zone

periods.label: Event day
tasks: Clear paths and complete safety walk
Brief helpers and prepare welcome drinks
Set cleanup kit and return boxes

dayOf.label: Setup
items: Secure cords, rugs and table linens
Use stable holders; keep flame away from fabric
Set alcohol-free drinks where clearly visible
Label dietary items and serving utensils
Check bathroom, coats and accessible seating

dayOf.label: During
items: Record borrowed items and last service times

dayOf.label: Cleanup and pack-away
items: Extinguish every flame and switch off lighting
Pack borrowed items with their owner labels
Check rooms, paths and transport arrangements
Record returns, damage and follow-up tasks
